assertions are skipped because the transport strips the tags header. The
v3 run (with `suppressions_datamode_changes.txt`) covers the FDv2 path,
including the `usePost` POST streaming variants.

The transport does not send the `x-launchdarkly-tags` header. The
streaming service's CORS allow-list does not include it, and the browser
preflight would fail.
